about: React Native's ActivityIndicator with Reduce Motion on (issue #559; progress-bar.h, docs/adr/0019-settings.mdx): the ring goes on turning, as a Mac's spinners go on spinning while their work is under way, but its arc no longer grows and shrinks: it is held at three quarters of a turn. sample/ProgressProbe.tsx's indicator, its rings held 133.3 ms into their animation (`progress_phase_ms`), where without Reduce Motion the arc is a short one from about 1 o'clock to 2 (the pixels at 6 and 9 o'clock background, and this fails): here it runs from about 1 o'clock round to 10, past 6 and 9.

steps.name: The indicator's arc three quarters of a turn long, still turning
